faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: A few clear answers before the full support center arrives.
faq.q1: How do I create an account?
faq.a1: Use Sign up, then verify your email once mailer is enabled.
faq.a2: Not yet — wallet and payments unlock in LOT 2.
faq.q3: Can I browse games without an account?
faq.a3: Yes. The catalog is open to browse; account features are available after signing up.
faq.q4: Where can I find current promotions?
faq.a4: Visit the Promotions page for the current welcome offer and weekly selections.
